comment: The model works in Moog volts: the input is scaled by 0.18 and then by 0.05 into the first capacitor and the output is divided back out (Flora.cpp:27, :28, :257). The tuning coefficient g and the resonance compensation Gres are polynomials in the cutoff, fitted by the maker (Flora.cpp:253, :254), and the feedback is taken a sample and a half back to put the phase shift near 180 degrees at the corner (Flora.cpp:285). Auto level divides by the drive clamped to a floor of 0.1 (Flora.cpp:257), and the setting is saved with the patch. Fauna is the same filter rebuilt with zero-delay feedback and a 20000Hz ceiling.
